essence: Generates a solid, colored circular matte centered at Center, then composites it over the layer using its opacity and blending mode. Radius sets the circle boundary; edge mode and inner/outer feathering determine how that boundary transitions, while Invert Circle swaps the filled interior for the surrounding area.
manifests_as: A colored disk or inverted outside-area fill appears at a chosen point, with an optionally hard or feathered circular boundary.

key_levers.name: Center
key_levers.effect: Moves the circle's geometric center; animate it to make the generated disk travel across the frame.

key_levers.name: Radius
key_levers.effect: Expands or contracts the circular boundary around Center; increasing it makes the disk cover more of the image.

key_levers.name: Edge
key_levers.effect: Selects the circle boundary construction, determining which side(s) of the circular edge can be treated as an edge rather than a fully solid fill.

key_levers.name: Feather Outer Edge
key_levers.effect: Softens the transition outward from the circle boundary; larger values spread the circle's falloff into the outside area.

key_levers.name: Feather Inner Edge
key_levers.effect: Softens the transition inward from the circle boundary; larger values eat softness into the circle interior.

key_levers.name: Invert Circle
key_levers.effect: Reverses the generated region: instead of coloring the circular interior, it colors the area outside the circle.

key_levers.name: Color
key_levers.effect: Sets the generated circle color before opacity and blend compositing.

key_levers.name: Opacity
key_levers.effect: Controls the visibility of the generated color; at 0 the Circle generation is invisible regardless of radius or feather.

enums_to_verify.Edge (ADBE Circle-0003, 1-5): Unverified: believed to choose among boundary/edge treatments, likely controlling whether the inner edge, outer edge, both, or neither is rendered/feathered.
enums_to_verify.Invert Circle (ADBE Circle-0009, 0-1): Unverified: believed to be 0 = normal filled interior and 1 = inverted, filled exterior.

config_recipes.hard white disk: Center 960,540; Radius 180; Edge 1 (default; verify); Feather Outer Edge 0; Feather Inner Edge 0; Invert Circle 0; Color white; Opacity 100.
config_recipes.soft expanding reveal: Center 960,540; animate Radius from 0 to 1100; Feather Outer Edge 80; Feather Inner Edge 0; Invert Circle 0; Color white; Opacity 100.
config_recipes.soft outside vignette: Center 960,540; Radius 430; Feather Outer Edge 0; Feather Inner Edge 140; Invert Circle 1; Color black; Opacity 55.

reasoning_hooks: Radius is measured from Center: moving Center relocates the whole construction, while changing Radius grows or shrinks it symmetrically.
Outer and inner feather act on opposite sides of the same circular boundary; use the feather matching the side you want to soften, especially after inversion.
Invert Circle changes which region receives the generated color, so a feather that looked like an outward glow in normal mode may read as an inward vignette after inversion.
Opacity only fades the generated Circle result; it does not alter the source layer's native alpha.
Edge is a mode selector with unavailable labels in introspection; verify its UI labels before relying on a numbered value in a preset.
